info.description: Code generated by scripts/gensdk from api/redx-api.json. DO NOT EDIT. Every operation carries x-redx-danger (safe < write < admin < dangerous) and x-redx-auth. SDKs refuse dangerous operations unless the call is confirmed.
info.title: RedX HTTP API

x-redx-danger-levels.meaning: changes data inside the key's own scope
x-redx-danger-levels.name: write

x-redx-danger-levels.meaning: changes host or database definitions; reversible
x-redx-danger-levels.name: admin

x-redx-danger-levels.meaning: irreversible, grants or removes access, or moves leadership; SDKs refuse it unless the call is explicitly confirmed
x-redx-danger-levels.name: dangerous

x-rottenapple-levels.notes: safe and write calls on the app's own workspace are the data.redx service (L1 in Rotten Apple's SDK levels). admin and dangerous calls are developer and operator tools only: they must not be exposed to in-app code through the launcher.

get.summary: Liveness, node id, role and version (no key needed).

get.summary: Online backup of all databases and keys as one archive (contains everything: store it safely).

Dashboard status: version, data dir, TLS, cluster, warnings.

post.description: Server requires header X-RedX-Confirm: createJoinToken (or ?confirm=createJoinToken); HTTP 428 + code confirm_required otherwise.
post.summary: Join token or pairing code that lets a node join and receive all data.

post.description: Server requires header X-RedX-Confirm: repoint (or ?confirm=repoint); HTTP 428 + code confirm_required otherwise.
post.summary: Make this node follow another leader (its own un-replicated writes are discarded).

post.description: Server requires header X-RedX-Confirm: promote (or ?confirm=promote); HTTP 428 + code confirm_required otherwise.
post.summary: Make this follower the leader (fences the old leader; unreplicated writes are lost).

get.summary: Role, leader, members, replication offsets, fence.
